name: GP Dixie Tableware Plant - Jackson TN

fieldNotes.facility: New $425M greenfield Dixie tableware manufacturing plant (paper plates/bowls/platters), 900,000 sq ft on 241 acres at 65 Cardinal Drive, west Jackson TN, near I-40 and TN-223. Production started June 2024; ribbon-cut Oct 2024. Roster coordinate (35.551418, -89.184861) was ~13 km SE in farmland; relocated via web research (65 Cardinal Drive, near I-40/Hwy 223) and confirmed in satellite + Feb-2026 Street View showing the building with the Georgia-Pacific logo.
fieldNotes.imagery: Maxar satellite of this area is from the construction era (~2023) — the building roof is visible but the truck dock yard not fully built. Feb-2026 Street View confirms the operational plant: large single building, full perimeter chain-link fence, dock apron with trailers on the east side, employee parking on the west.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced ~247-acre site (continuous chain-link perimeter confirmed in Street View). The truck driveway enters off Cardinal Drive; a controlled gate is standard for a modern greenfield manufacturing plant. Called true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth imaged; a modern cost-efficient greenfield plant with ~220 employees typically uses kiosk / app / call-box check-in rather than a 24/7 manned booth — set guardShack false, remoteGs true. Both flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single 900,000 sq ft building with a long dock apron on the east side; ~40 doors estimated — low confidence band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked at the dock apron in Street View; no dedicated separate drop lot visible — dropArea 0-10, dropYard false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property — site is near I-40, served by truck.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: New site with ample paved width and a long driveway approach; inferred room to add a bypass lane — low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — greenfield site on former farmland on the western edge of Jackson, surrounded by open fields.
